# GitHub Copilot instructions

**Concise, compact, facts only.**

Router only — full instructions: [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md). Product: [`PRD.md`](../PRD.md). Structure: [`ARCHITECTURE.md`](../ARCHITECTURE.md). Specs: [`docs/specs/`](../docs/specs/).

Read `AGENTS.md` first, follow it exactly: `docs/specs/` is authoritative, every behavior change passes its gates before code changes. Exists so Copilot's own instructions-file lookup finds its way in — not a duplicate of `AGENTS.md`.
